repo: Swamp3/bike-one-shop (existing repo; website/ merged in at the end)

decisions.choice: website/ is built as a standalone git repo (kit needs its own main + astro-rebuild), hidden from the parent via .git/info/exclude, then merged into bike-one-shop with history under website/
decisions.reason: user: use the repo we are in, website and shop combine; init-site always runs git init and commits to main
decisions.costIfWrong: low: the merge is a read-tree at the end

decisions.choice: out of scope: shop, product, category, brand, cart, checkout, account, wishlist paths excluded from capture
decisions.reason: user: ignore woocommerce, the new shop is this repo
decisions.costIfWrong: medium: excluded pages need a link or redirect to the new shop

decisions.choice: Cloudflare Pages; development on bike-one.dev, always noindex (PUBLIC_INDEXABLE unset)
decisions.reason: user: domain registered at Cloudflare; bike-one.dev must not be indexed
decisions.costIfWrong: low

decisions.choice: woo default and German slugs: /shop/ /product/ /product-category/ /product-brand/ /brand/ /cart/ /checkout/ /my-account/ /wishlist/ /produkt/ /produkt-kategorie/ /warenkorb/ /kasse/ /mein-konto/ /wunschliste/
decisions.reason: real slugs unknown before capture; adjust with --resume --exclude
decisions.costIfWrong: low

decisions.choice: trailing slash always (54 of 54 pages)
decisions.reason: capture
decisions.costIfWrong: none

decisions.choice: live-temporary: 2009 files, 1156.7 MB, 5 over 25 MB (largest 91.9 MB mp4); R2 mode needed, no R2 credentials; staging serves /wp-content/uploads/ from bike-one.org. 4108 unreferenced WordPress sizes listed, not downloaded
decisions.reason: over 300 MB limit; no store credentials
decisions.costIfWrong: high if forgotten: bike-one.org is replaced at launch, so images break. Must move to R2 before DNS

decisions.choice: 10 templates from 55 pages as clustered (template-1 15 portfolio demo, page 10, archive 9 brands, template-2 7 team demo, single-post 5, page-3 4, archive-3 2, archive-2 1, home 1, page-2 1)
decisions.reason: capture/templates.json
decisions.costIfWrong: low

decisions.reason: parity; removal is a proposal
decisions.costIfWrong: none for launch

decisions.choice: reproduce live: 27 pages have no h1 (home, brands, categories, legal, booking, about)
decisions.reason: parity; fix is a proposal
decisions.costIfWrong: SEO stays as today

decisions.choice: none to rewire: the only POST forms are WooCommerce add-to-cart on /, GET search on /Marke/*; markup reproduced, cart no longer works
decisions.reason: inventory.json forms
decisions.costIfWrong: none

decisions.reason: user: ignore woocommerce
decisions.costIfWrong: medium: dead product links on staging until the new shop takes those paths

decisions.choice: keep etermin.net booking iframes (/termin-buchen-oldenburg/, -osnabrueck/) and Google Maps iframes (/termin-buchen/)
decisions.reason: third-party embeds
decisions.costIfWrong: low

decisions.choice: none found in capture/scripts.json
decisions.reason: capture
decisions.costIfWrong: none

decisions.choice: skipped, not installed
decisions.reason: never install unasked
decisions.costIfWrong: suggestions list performance as Not covered

decisions.choice: 3 POST forms on / switched off: action=# and listed in inert-forms.json; no form endpoint, no Formspree
decisions.reason: cart forms must never post to a form service; shop is out of scope
decisions.costIfWrong: low: buttons do nothing until the new shop takes over

decisions.choice: src/layouts/Page.astro (plus Blank.astro for /alle-fahrrader/) for all 10 templates instead of one layout per template; header, mobile header and footer are components from home, pages with a current-menu-item copy use their own file
decisions.reason: all templates share the identical #page > .site-inner > header, mobile header, #main, footer skeleton; content moved by tools/extract.mjs
decisions.costIfWrong: low

decisions.choice: reproduce live: fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet stays linked, the 20 fonts the capture saved under /fonts/ are not shipped
decisions.reason: parity; self-hosting is a proposal (German courts treat Google Fonts from Google servers as a GDPR issue)
decisions.costIfWrong: medium: GDPR exposure until proposed change is approved

decisions.choice: public/_headers adds X-Robots-Tag noindex for https://bike-one.dev/*; builds are noindex and robots Disallow all unless PUBLIC_INDEXABLE=true
decisions.reason: user: bike-one.dev must not be indexed
decisions.costIfWrong: low

decisions.choice: reproduce live: every page links /wp-content/themes/cosy-child/favicon.png, which live answers 404; link kept, links exception per page
decisions.reason: parity; the root /favicon.ico is served
decisions.costIfWrong: none

decisions.choice: the live wp-sitemap files are served from tools/sitemaps.mjs: URLs under the excluded WooCommerce prefixes (53) are dropped, the two sitemaps left empty (products, product categories) are dropped from the index, and /portfolio-category/branding-design/page/2/ is added because the sitemaps gate requires every indexable page and live omits it
decisions.reason: the sitemaps gate has no exception field; forced difference from live
decisions.costIfWrong: low: the new shop adds its own sitemap entries

decisions.topic: same-origin asset URLs root-relative / local media
decisions.choice: tools/extract.mjs rewrites live-origin URLs to root-relative in script/img/source/video src, srcset, stylesheet/icon/preload links, import maps, inline style url() and data-* lazy sources (<a href>, canonical, og and other head metadata stay); media mode is repo: 2009 files copied by assets:copy from .conversion/media-cache into public/wp-content/uploads, gitignored
decisions.default: same-origin asset URLs root-relative; media live-temporary
decisions.reason: user: serve images locally; live host was unreachable; build-rules default. data-* rewrite goes beyond the rule so the theme lazy loaders and the pager use local files
decisions.costIfWrong: medium: the 1.1 GB media is not in git; production needs R2 (5 files exceed the 25 MiB Cloudflare Pages limit) or another store

decisions.choice: dropped with their inline config: WooCommerce cart fragments (wc-cart-fragments-js, -extra), YITH add-to-wishlist (yith-wcwl-add-to-wishlist-js, -extra, -translations), WordPress emoji loader (wp-emoji-settings JSON and its module script); dev-host bikeone.cvires.at file URLs (blog images, slider poster) now point at the local copies
decisions.default: copy every script that drives visible behaviour; drop only scripts that do nothing on a static site
decisions.reason: user: fix console errors; each script only called endpoints that do not exist on a static host (405 on ?wc-ajax, wp-json/yith, wp-emoji-release.min.js on the live origin); the dev host leaked into live content
decisions.costIfWrong: low: browsers without flag-emoji support show country letters instead of flags; wishlist and cart widgets were already dead

decisions.choice: header and footer menus: GravelBikes, RoadBikes and TT/Triathlon replaced by one Shop item (tools/extract.mjs) linking to https://shop.bike-one.dev/ in local, dev and staging builds and to https://shop.bike-one.org/ in the release build (PUBLIC_INDEXABLE=true); SHOP_URL in src/lib/site.mjs; the pages /racebikes/, /tt-triathlon/ and /gravel-bikes/ stay built and unlinked
decisions.reason: owner request
decisions.costIfWrong: low: the shop sites must exist before launch; the three pages could be dropped with redirects if wanted

decisions.choice: tools/strip-sourcemaps.mjs removes sourceMappingURL comments from 3 served JS files (lightbox, swiper, yith add-to-wishlist); run it after npm run assets:copy
decisions.reason: the .map files were never captured, DevTools logs a source map error on every page
decisions.costIfWrong: none

decisions.choice: inline script hero-video-autoplay added to / and /main-bike/: every 500 ms it plays the unstarted bg video of the visible Revolution Slider slide (muted); VidOne.mp4 stays at the absolute live URL because the file is not in the capture or the export
decisions.reason: owner report: poster shows until a click. Reproduced in WebKit (Safari engine): the slider never calls play() on the first video, a muted play() without gesture succeeds and the slider then fades the video in. Chrome autoplays by itself
decisions.costIfWrong: low: a no-op where autoplay already works; Safari with Low Power Mode can still block autoplay

decisions.choice: VidOne.mp4 (27,844,858 bytes, HEVC hvc1, no audio) is served from this site as /VidOne.mp4 (public/VidOne.mp4); tools/extract.mjs rewrites data-mp4/webm/ogv from the live origin to root-relative; the routes gate gets --allow-extra /VidOne.mp4 baked into the verify scripts in package.json. Supersedes the absolute live URL in d25
decisions.reason: owner request: the file lives only on the live host; it was downloaded once with the owner's consent. Not in the baseline, so it is an extra built file
decisions.costIfWrong: high for hosting: the file is 26.55 MiB, over the 25 MiB Cloudflare Pages limit, so wrangler pages deploy fails until it is shrunk or served from R2; HEVC does not play in Firefox or Chromium without HEVC

decisions.topic: no links to the live site
decisions.choice: tools/extract.mjs makes same-origin URLs root-relative in a/area href, form action, link rel=alternate (feeds), data-* attributes (also WooCommerce variation JSON), inline script config (plain, JSON-escaped and URL-encoded) and <template> contents (the extractor did not enter template.content, which is why the wc-placeholder img stayed absolute); links to WooCommerce paths (/product/, /product-category/, /shop/, /cart/, /checkout/, /my-account/, /wishlist/) stay as paths, no shop URL invented; the redirect map for shop.bike-one.org is in .working-files/bike-one-links/notes.md
decisions.reason: owner report: the rebuild still links to bike-one.org; the links gate counts both forms as internal
decisions.costIfWrong: low: a script that compared an absolute origin would break; the console probe on 5 pages at 2 widths shows no new message

decisions.choice: tools/extract.mjs removes link rel=https://api.w.org/, EditURI, pingback, shortlink and rel=alternate links to wp-json (oEmbed, REST) from every page; the 284 WordPress API link records are gone from exceptions.json and npm run links:exceptions passes --skip-api so it does not add them back
decisions.default: keep the captured head links (d19 exceptions)
decisions.reason: owner report; a static site has no xmlrpc.php, wp-json or short URL endpoints
decisions.costIfWrong: low: no oEmbed discovery, no pingbacks; shortlink ?p= URLs still redirect through redirects.csv

decisions.topic: dev builds name the dev origin
decisions.choice: postbuild step tools/dev-origin.mjs: unless PUBLIC_INDEXABLE=true it rewrites every form of https://bike-one.org (http, //, www, JSON-escaped, URL-encoded) in the text files of dist (html xml txt json xsl js css, _redirects, _headers; not wp-content/uploads) to SITE_ORIGIN, default https://bike-one.dev; the release build is untouched; npm run verify goes through tools/verify.mjs, which gives the gates --origin SITE_ORIGIN on a dev build and nothing on the release build
decisions.reason: owner: the test deployment on bike-one.dev must not reference bike-one.org; canonical, sitemaps and feeds cannot be root-relative
decisions.costIfWrong: low: an npx astro build without npm run build skips the step; set SITE_ORIGIN for another test host

decisions.choice: astro.config.mjs sets `site` to https://bike-one.org in the release build (PUBLIC_INDEXABLE=true), else SITE_ORIGIN or https://bike-one.dev; canonical, Open Graph and JSON-LD URLs come from it; tools/dev-origin.mjs stays as a safety net
decisions.default: site fixed to bike-one.org and rewritten after the build (d29)
decisions.reason: native components build absolute URLs; the origin should be right at build time, not patched afterwards
decisions.costIfWrong: low: a build without PUBLIC_INDEXABLE names bike-one.dev, which is the intended dev behaviour

decisions.topic: no inline styles or scripts, no data: assets
decisions.choice: build.inlineStylesheets never and vite assetsInlineLimit 0: every native page links its CSS and JS as files; no style attributes in native components
decisions.default: Astro inlines small CSS and scripts
decisions.reason: lets the CSP stay default-src self without unsafe-inline
decisions.costIfWrong: low: one more request per page, cached immutable under /_astro/

decisions.topic: explicit shrinking allowlist of pages still on the old route
decisions.choice: tools/legacy.mjs lists the 51 paths (plus /404.html) that src/pages/[...path].astro still builds from captured markup, the dist prefixes and src paths only they use; the new checks skip exactly these; migrated pages leave the list; Stage 2 empties it. Layouts and components of the old route moved to src/layouts/legacy and src/components/legacy
decisions.default: all pages stay on the old route until every page is migrated
decisions.reason: the build must not break between stages and the checks must not hide new problems
decisions.costIfWrong: low: an entry that is still listed after its page is native is reported as stale by the checks

decisions.topic: native home, Ueber uns, Impressum, Datenschutz
decisions.choice: src/pages/index.astro, ueber-uns.astro and [legal].astro build the four pages from tokens, Base/Header/Footer/SEO and the content collections; home has a poster-only hero (no video, no slider), the two stores, the five service texts from the captured home page, the seven brand names as text, the three newest posts; product tiles, partner logos and the WooCommerce markup are dropped
decisions.default: IA table of the plan (hero, stores, services teaser, brands, latest posts)
decisions.reason: vertical slice that proves the pipeline; text is copied from capture/text/home.txt and ueber-uns.txt
decisions.costIfWrong: low: Stage 2 adds the video helper and the service page; partner logos need confirmed alt texts and are not on the new home page

decisions.choice: src/content.config.ts defines stores (json, two entries with address, phone, e-mail, hours), brands (json, seven names), legal (Markdown, Impressum and Datenschutz text from the capture) and blog (front matter only for the five posts: title, dates, excerpt from capture/wp-rest/posts.json; bodies and pages follow in Stage 2)
decisions.reason: one typed source for the footer, the home page, the store cards and the JSON-LD
decisions.costIfWrong: low

decisions.choice: src/styles/tokens.css takes the shop wireframes language (accent #e63946, header #121212, surfaces #f8f9fa, ink #212529, line #dee2e6), mobile first, light surfaces with dark header, footer and hero; --accent-strong #c92a37 for buttons and text because #e63946 is 4.2:1 on white; no dark colour scheme yet
decisions.default: plan assumption: reuse the shop wireframe tokens
decisions.reason: site and shop look like one brand; WCAG AA text contrast
decisions.costIfWrong: medium: a different direction means new tokens and component CSS, the markup stays

decisions.choice: owner decision: @fontsource/roboto 5.3.0 (400, 700) and @fontsource/roboto-condensed 5.3.0 (700), dev dependencies pinned exactly; hand-written @font-face in src/styles/fonts.css points at the packages woff2 files (latin and latin-ext with unicode-range, font-display swap) so Vite emits them under /_astro/; the Roboto Condensed 700 latin file is the one preload; no request to googleapis or gstatic
decisions.reason: owner: install the fonts locally with npm; per-weight CSS of the packages adds a woff fallback and has no unicode-range
decisions.costIfWrong: low: three small packages, only the woff2 files end up in dist

decisions.topic: store address spelling on new pages
decisions.choice: Rheinstraße 16 and Lengericher Landstraße 30 in the footer, store cards and JSON-LD (the capture mixes Rheinstr./Rheinstrasse and Landstr./Landstraße); the legal texts keep their own spelling word for word
decisions.reason: seo-review M10: one NAP spelling
decisions.costIfWrong: low

decisions.topic: legal pages rendered from Markdown, text unchanged
decisions.choice: src/content/legal/impressum.md and datenschutz.md hold the captured words; only structure changed: title as h1, section titles as h2, bullets as lists, manual line wraps inside sentences joined with a space, address blocks keep their line breaks; the private-use bullet glyph is dropped; known text defects (TMG, ZugriƯ, IPAdresse, URL cut by a line break) are not touched and are listed in notes-stage1.md
decisions.reason: plan: legal text verbatim; native Astro without set:html of captured markup
decisions.costIfWrong: low: test/legal-verbatim.test.mjs compares the rendered words with capture/text

decisions.choice: the header menu is a popover (button with popovertarget on narrow screens, always visible from 48rem by author CSS), Shop item links to SHOP_URL (d23)
decisions.reason: plan: prefer native features; keyboard operable, closes on Escape and outside click
decisions.costIfWrong: low: popover is baseline since 2024, older browsers show no menu button action

decisions.choice: src/components/Embed.astro: the iframe sits in a template and is inserted on a click (about 15 lines of script, delegated listener); text names the provider and the IP transfer; the map on Ueber uns uses the key-free https://www.google.com/maps?q=...&output=embed form instead of the captured keyed URL
decisions.reason: no third-party request before consent by click; the captured API key does not belong in the repository
decisions.costIfWrong: medium: the key-free embed URL could not be tested offline; the German consent wording is for legal review

decisions.choice: npm run verify runs tools/checks/{redirects,links,seo,wp,size,a11y,net}.mjs on dist/ (tools/verify.mjs); native pages are checked in full, pages and files on the tools/legacy.mjs allowlist are skipped, a stale allowlist entry fails; the kit gates under scripts/verify stay as npm run verify:legacy until Stage 4; net runs Chrome and WebKit at 1440 and 390 against the review server and applies the CSP from dist/_headers
decisions.reason: owner: redesign, not parity; the gates compare against the live site and fail by design
decisions.costIfWrong: low: each check is a small script over dist/, no dependency added

decisions.choice: tools/redirect-map.mjs holds the IA redirect rows as data, tools/redirects-build.mjs writes redirects.csv (token {SHOP_URL}) and cloudflare-query-redirects.csv (production shop) and, after astro build, dist/_redirects for the dev or production shop; a row exists only for a URL without a page (pages on tools/legacy.mjs wait), shortlink rows are re-pointed at their final destination; public/_redirects is no longer committed; in Stage 1 the rows cover the shop prefixes (46 known product, category and shop URLs, 15 prefix rules) and the old WordPress sitemap names
decisions.reason: the shop target differs between dev and production builds and the map must apply itself as pages leave the old route
decisions.costIfWrong: low: Stage 2 shrinks the allowlist and reruns npm run redirects:build

decisions.choice: robots.txt: dev Disallow all, release Allow plus a Sitemap line; tools/sitemap-build.mjs (postbuild) lists exactly the indexable native pages in sitemap-0.xml and sitemap-index.xml, release build only (a dev build is noindex and has no sitemap); the old wp-sitemap files stay until Stage 2 redirects them
decisions.reason: plan: native sitemap and robots, dev Disallow all, release Allow plus sitemap
decisions.costIfWrong: low: pages on the old route are not in the sitemap until they are migrated

decisions.choice: public/_headers: Permissions-Policy (camera, microphone, geolocation off) for every path; a CSP with default-src self, script-src self, style-src self, img-src self data:, font-src self, media-src self, frame-src only the three embed hosts (etermin.net, google.com/maps, bike-leasing-calculator.jobrad.org), object-src none, form-action self, frame-ancestors self, for the four native paths only
decisions.reason: plan: CSP without third parties; the pages still on the old route use inline scripts and would break, so the rule is per native path until Stage 2 turns it into /*
decisions.costIfWrong: low: the net check applies the same header in Playwright and fails on any violation

decisions.topic: head texts of the four pages
decisions.choice: titles 30 to 60 characters and descriptions 70 to 160, unique, written from each page own captured text, German; home h1 is the captured footer tagline without its full stop; no E-Bike or Rennrad claim in the home title (seo-review H1 asks the client to confirm the assortment); JSON-LD graph (Organization, WebSite, two BikeStore nodes) on home and Ueber uns, BreadcrumbList with a visible breadcrumb on inner pages, no geo, rating, price range or sameAs
decisions.reason: plan: SEO section; facts only from the capture
decisions.costIfWrong: low: copy to be reviewed in Stage 3

decisions.choice: src/content/blog/*.md hold the five posts: body converted from the captured entry-content (paragraphs, h2/h3, lists, bold; the WordPress separators dropped; no text changed, a test compares every rendered body with capture/text), plus seoTitle (43 to 47 characters) and description written from each post, one image from the media cache (leasing: ETS16549, safety: DAY2_6THST, service: DAY2_SR39, E-Bike: showroom photo, fatigue: fitting photo) with a plain alt text; /blog/ lists the five newest first; each post has Article + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD (the organisation is author and publisher, the WordPress author had no name), a booking CTA, a link to /service/ and the other posts; native RSS 2.0 at /feed/ (src/pages/feed/index.xml.js, excerpts, served by a 200 rewrite /feed/ -> /feed/index.xml in _redirects); the posts keep their slugs
decisions.reason: plan: content collection, verbatim text, Article data, native RSS
decisions.costIfWrong: low: the Austrian and Vienna statements in two posts are the captured copy (flagged for the owner); the E-Bike title is 115 characters, far over the 110 that Google suggests for an Article headline (the head title is the short seoTitle)

decisions.choice: New page /service/ built from the service copy of the old /main-bike/ page (capture/text/main-bike.txt): Bike-Fitting, Dienstradleasing (with the JobRad example calculator behind the click-to-load embed), Werkstattservice, the Service paragraph, Canyon Collect&Ride and Canyon Service; text word for word except the typos listed in notes-stage2 (dich sich, den, weitern, Buche), the [/vc_column][/vc_row] leak, the old home greeting (Herzlich Wilkommen) and the three shop category tiles are not copied; h1 "Service bei BikeOne" is a page title, not a claim; linked from header, footer, home and the booking and post pages; /main-bike/ redirects 301 to /service/; no partner logos
decisions.reason: plan: new /service/ page from the old copy
decisions.costIfWrong: low: the 40 % claim and the Canyon partnership are the captured copy and need the owner confirmation

decisions.choice: /termin-buchen/ (both stores from the stores collection, StoreCard), /termin-buchen-oldenburg/ and /termin-buchen-osnabrueck/ (src/pages/[booking].astro): h1, address, hours, phone and e-mail from the collection, etermin.net (https://www.etermin.net/bike-one and /os1, field bookingUrl) in a template behind the click-to-load Embed (new ratio "app"), a plain "bei eTermin öffnen" link for visitors without JavaScript, links to the other store, /ueber-uns/ and /service/; titles "Termin buchen in <city> – BikeOne", descriptions from the store facts, BikeStore + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD; the overview question gets its question mark
decisions.default: iframe in the page, slug as title
decisions.reason: plan: click-to-load etermin, titles that are not slugs
decisions.costIfWrong: low: the consent sentence on the placeholder is ours (legal review)

decisions.choice: Native page from the captured list, grouped by location (Zentrale Oldenburg, Filiale Oldenburg, Filiale Osnabrück); "keine stellen" corrected to "Stellen"; no application contact invented, a link to /ueber-uns/ only; no JobPosting data (it would need dates and terms that are not in the capture)
decisions.reason: plan: short page from the captured text
decisions.costIfWrong: low: the list is as old as the capture; the owner must confirm the openings

decisions.choice: All seven /Marke/<brand>/ pages redirect 301 to the shop (also /marke/*, lower case): the capture holds only product listings for them (filter UI, prices, manufacturer copy, leasing rates), no copy of the shop or BikeOne; their feeds go to /feed/. The home page keeps the brand names as plain text
decisions.default: a native landing page per brand
decisions.reason: plan: keep a page only where non-product copy exists; none does
decisions.costIfWrong: medium: seo-review M4 wanted local brand landing pages; that needs new copy from the owner

decisions.choice: public/hero.mp4: H.264 (avc1), 1280x720, 13.4 s, no audio track, moov before mdat (faststart), 17.67 MiB, made from the HEVC original with /usr/bin/avconvert Preset1280x720 --multiPass (1920x1080 gave 25.2 MiB, over the limit); the HEVC public/VidOne.mp4 is removed from the tree. src/components/HeroVideo.astro: <video muted loop playsinline preload="none"> over the poster photo, play() only after load, only from 48rem up (17.7 MiB), not with prefers-reduced-motion, not with Save-Data, a pause button (WCAG 2.2.2), a first tap/click/key starts it when the browser refuses autoplay; tools/mp4-info.mjs reads codec, atoms and size; net checks start (Chrome without a click, WebKit with the first click), no request at 390 and with reduced motion
decisions.reason: plan: H.264 under 20 MiB, poster plus helper
decisions.costIfWrong: medium: Playwright WebKit refuses muted autoplay even on a bare test page, so Safari without a click is not proven here; 720p is softer than the 1080p original

decisions.topic: old route, allowlist and WordPress files out of dist
decisions.choice: src/pages/[...path].astro, the legacy layouts and components, tools/legacy.mjs and every allowlist in the checks are deleted; public/{wp-content,wp-includes,Marke,author,category,comments,feed,portfolio-category,wp-sitemap*} moved with git mv to legacy-public/ (outside public/, so nothing of it is published; uploads stay git-ignored there), the sources src/content/{pages,heads,bottoms,parts,index.json} and src/styles/{inline,site.css} stay until Stage 4 and are the only src paths the wp check skips (STAGE4_SOURCES); dist/ no longer holds any WordPress file
decisions.default: keep the old route until Stage 4
decisions.reason: plan: Stage 2 empties the allowlist, nothing in dist/ comes from the WordPress files
decisions.costIfWrong: low: tools/extract.mjs and scripts/copy-assets.mjs still point at public/wp-content (old pipeline, Stage 4 deletes them)

decisions.choice: src/pages/404.astro to dist/404.html: German text, links to home, booking, blog and shop, noindex in every build, no canonical and no og:url (it answers for any URL); the seo check expects exactly that
decisions.reason: plan: native 404
decisions.costIfWrong: none

decisions.choice: public/_headers: one /* rule with the security headers and the CSP (default-src self; frame-src only etermin.net, google.com/maps, the JobRad calculator host; img-src self data:; media-src self); X-Robots-Tag noindex for https://bike-one.dev/* and https://*.pages.dev/* kept
decisions.reason: plan: one /* rule
decisions.costIfWrong: low: the net check applies the rule in both browsers and fails on a violation

decisions.topic: redirects and checks without the old route
decisions.choice: tools/redirect-map.mjs: /Marke/* and /marke/* to the shop, brand feeds to /feed/, wp-sitemap names to /sitemap-index.xml, /main-bike/ to /service/, demo pages to /, author and category pages to /blog/, WooCommerce paths to the shop; the generator writes a row for every old URL the map sends elsewhere (no stillBuilt test), passes only /feed/ as 200 rewrite to build-redirects; the redirects check accepts a 200 rewrite as served, the links check resolves /feed/ through it; the net check also tests the hero video; all checks scan everything with no allowlist
decisions.reason: plan: every URL in baseline/routes.json resolves in one hop
decisions.costIfWrong: low

decisions.choice: beratung, konfiguration: the full-size originals of the two screenshots (1280x1042, 1222x994) instead of the 1024 px versions; leasing: ETS16549.jpg (the screenshot was a crop of it) at 2000 px; werkstatt stays (the original is 950 px wide, there is no larger one); new sicherheit.jpg and service.jpg from the DAY2 studio shots for two posts (the werkstatt photo is too small for a 1200x630 share image); no partner logos

decisions.choice: src/components/SEO.astro builds one @graph per page: Organization (logo 512x512, brands, department only for the stores in that graph) and WebSite on every page except the 404, plus the page nodes (BikeStore per store, Article, BreadcrumbList); a store node links to its booking page (was /ueber-uns/ for both); article and sitemap dates are written in Berlin time (berlinIso) so the date part is the day on the page (the UTC day was one day early for 01:25 posts); posts carry article:published_time and article:modified_time, the release sitemap gets lastmod for the posts only (no date is guessed for other pages)
decisions.default: JSON-LD only on home, Ueber uns and the pages with their own nodes; UTC dates
decisions.reason: every @id reference must resolve inside its page, and Google does not follow an @id to another page; the visible date is the Berlin date
decisions.costIfWrong: low: Organization and WebSite repeat on each page (about 1.2 KB of HTML)

decisions.choice: tools/checks/seo.mjs now also checks: slug-like titles; claim words (E-Bike, Rennrad, Gravel, Leasing, Fitting, Werkstatt, Canyon, brands, percentages, prices, ratings) in a title or description must occur in the page own text; Open Graph and Twitter fields agree with title, description and each other, og:image 1200x630 under 300 KB with matching width and height tags, article times; JSON-LD types limited to Organization, WebSite, BikeStore, BreadcrumbList, Article (no JobPosting, Review, Product, FAQPage), the node set per page type, @id references, breadcrumbs equal the visible crumbs and end at the canonical URL, Article equals h1, canonical, visible date and image, BikeStore address, phone, e-mail and hours are in the visible page text; vague anchor text, one link text pointing at two targets, every page except the legal pages linked from the content of another page; sitemap namespace, absolute URLs and lastmod; the RSS feed against the posts; test/seo-data.test.mjs compares the store, hours and brand data with the captured text
decisions.default: title, description, canonical, Open Graph and JSON-LD parse checks only
decisions.reason: plan: keep the SEO rules enforced; claims only from the page copy
decisions.costIfWrong: low: a legitimate new claim word has to be added to the page copy or the CLAIMS list

decisions.choice: home links to /ueber-uns/ (stores section); Ueber uns gets "Mehr ueber BikeOne" with links to /service/, /blog/ and /stellenangebote/ (the jobs page had no content link); /service/ gets "Mehr dazu im Blog" with the three posts about leasing, workshop and fitting; the blog index links to the booking page and /service/; the 404 button is "Zum Blog"; anchor text names the target

decisions.topic: titles and descriptions reviewed against seo-review.md

decisions.reason: plan Stage 3: review against seo-review.md

decisions.choice: tools/lib/contrast.mjs and the a11y check compute WCAG ratios for every colour pair the stylesheets use (text 4.5:1, control borders and the focus ring 3:1) from tokens.css; --line-strong (ghost button border) #adb5bd (1.97:1) becomes #7b848c (3.4 to 3.8:1); the footer button no longer turns grey on hover (4.0:1 against its hover colour); the hero shade is checked on the real pixels (poster and five video frames, white text 5.5:1 and more) and now runs from the left on wide screens so the photo stays visible
decisions.reason: WCAG 2.2 AA 1.4.3 and 1.4.11; owner: 4.5:1 for text and 3:1 for UI
decisions.costIfWrong: low: the ghost border is darker

decisions.choice: links on their own line, footer lists, the logo and breadcrumb links are at least 44 px high (wide: footer rows, breadcrumbs and address links only on a phone or a touch screen, @media (max-width: 47.99rem), (pointer: coarse)); the breadcrumb is one line and cuts a long post title with an ellipsis; the embed hands the focus to the iframe it inserts (the focused button is removed); legal and post text may break inside a long URL (the Impressum ODR link widened the page by 13 px at 390); the click-to-load map keeps a minimum height of 14 rem

decisions.costIfWrong: low

decisions.topic: browser checks ui, embeds, headers in verify
decisions.choice: tools/checks/ui.mjs (Chrome: focus ring on every Tab stop with the skip link first, 44 px targets at 390, menu and hero pause button with the keyboard, reduced motion, white text on the photos, no horizontal scrolling), embeds.mjs (every click-to-load embed by mouse, Enter and Space in Chrome and WebKit under the real CSP: before the activation no foreign request, after it exactly one, aborted by the test, to the embed host, no CSP error, focus on the iframe), headers.mjs (_headers: nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP without unsafe-inline, wildcard or http, frame-src exactly the three hosts, X-Robots-Tag for bike-one.dev and *.pages.dev, Cloudflare limits for _headers and _redirects, no http:// URL in dist); shared tools/lib/browser.mjs; verify runs 10 checks (about 3 minutes)
decisions.reason: plan Stage 3: CSP verified in the network test, keyboard use, contrast
decisions.costIfWrong: low: a slower verify

decisions.topic: consent text of the three embeds
decisions.choice: src/components/Embed.astro: "{Die Karte|Die Terminbuchung|Der Beispielrechner} wird von {Google Maps|eTermin|JobRad} bereitgestellt. Beim Laden verbindet sich dein Browser mit {Anbieter} und deine IP-Adresse wird uebertragen." instead of the generic sentence with "Ihre IP-Adresse" (Sie) that did not say what is loaded; prop subject added

decisions.choice: src/lib/preload.ts: the LCP image of home, Ueber uns, the posts and /service/ is preloaded as the AVIF srcset with the widths and sizes its picture uses (type image/avif, fetchpriority high), the first service block is eager with fetchpriority high; measured at slow 4G (1.6 Mbit/s, 150 ms) home 1440: LCP 1.17 s to 0.82 s, /service/ 1.30 s to 0.70 s; size checks that the high-priority image is preloaded with exactly its srcset and sizes and that every img has width, height, a srcset and AVIF and WebP sources; net checks that no /_astro file is fetched twice
decisions.default: fetchpriority high on the image only
decisions.reason: plan: LCP image preloaded or fetchpriority high; measured gain
decisions.costIfWrong: low: browsers without AVIF skip the preload and use the picture fallbacks; a merged single stylesheet was measured and rejected (first view slower on slow 4G)

decisions.topic: fallback fonts with the metrics of the web fonts
decisions.choice: src/styles/fonts.css: Roboto Fallback (400, 700) and Roboto Condensed Fallback (700) on local Arial with size-adjust 99.1, 93.5 and 83.3 percent (measured width ratios on German copy) and ascent, descent and gap overrides from the fonts hhea table; tokens.css puts them behind the web fonts; with the font files delayed by 1.8 s the layout shift of the blog page went from 0.0089 to 0
decisions.default: Arial Narrow and Arial as the fallback
decisions.reason: plan: no layout shift from fonts
decisions.costIfWrong: low: where Arial is missing the next family of the stack is used

decisions.topic: hero video on a metered or slow connection
decisions.choice: HeroVideo.astro: after the load event and from 48 rem up the video starts only when navigator.connection is absent (Safari, Firefox: unchanged behaviour) or not saveData, not type cellular and effectiveType not slow-2g, 2g or 3g; the connection is read again on its change event; net tests the five cases with a mocked connection. Real Chrome desktop does not expose type and reports effectiveType 4g also at 1.6 Mbit/s, so the policy protects Android Chrome and Save-Data users, not a slow desktop line. The encode is unchanged (17.67 MiB)
decisions.default: play after load, not with Save-Data
decisions.reason: owner: data-conscious loading if safe
decisions.costIfWrong: low: an iPad on cellular still loads 17.7 MiB (no API); a pointer: fine condition would cover it, owner to decide

decisions.choice: tools/perf.mjs (LCP element and time, CLS, requests and bytes per page and viewport, Chrome, WebKit, optional CDP throttling) and tools/screens.mjs (full-page screenshots at 390, 768 and 1440 into review/) with npm run perf and npm run screens; not gates
decisions.reason: Stage 3 measurements must be repeatable
decisions.costIfWrong: none

decisions.choice: The home hero is the poster photo only (owner): no <video>, no pause button, no request for a video.
